elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that Customer is not liable for any liquidated damages, penalty, or similar charge for late payment; the replacement remedy is simple interest, not a liquidated amount or penalty.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount remains in the rendered clause, so the condition is demonstrably absent and the stronger no-liquidated-damages position applies.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no early-termination fee; therefore there is no such fee exceeding the three-month cap.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: No early-termination fee or other liquidated amount is payable by Customer under the rendered clause, satisfying this fallback element through the stronger exclusion.
